The '''2025 Retro Online Championship Series''' ('''ROCS''') was the year-end playoff of the [[2025 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]], played in December 2025. [[Joe Horbey]] beat [[Jonny Chu]] in the finals.<ref name="t86215">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86215 2025 Retro Online Championship Series], forum.starwarsccg.org; event structure by Leverandon (18 November 2025), quarterfinal results (8 December 2025), semifinal and final pairings and final ranking (24 December 2025), and decks archive posted by hdwgitm (16 January 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012164456/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86215.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==
* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)<ref name="pool">All sixteen GEMP files in the decks archive use only cards from Premiere through Death Star II plus Decipher premium sets. The forum thread lists the formats the qualifiers could vote for but does not name the winner.</ref>
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Players:''' the top 8 of the 2025 Retro League cumulative standings
* '''Structure:''' single elimination, two games per match (one per side), better net differential advances<ref name="t86215" />
